answer_1.quote: Multimodal summarization for open-domain videos, first organized as a track of the How2 Challenge at the ICML 2019 workshop, aims to integrate multisource information of videos (video, audio, transcript) into a fluent textual summary.
answer_1.outputs: textual summary that describes the most salient part of the video

answer_2.quote: We adopt multiple automatic metrics to comprehensively evaluate model performance: BLEU (1,2,3,4), ROUGE (1,2,L), METEOR and CIDEr.
